definitions.gloss: again, once more, a second time
definitions.explanation: Indicates something happening for another time after a previous occurrence.

examples.japanese: {再|ふたた}び⟦{会|あ}える→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみにしています→楽しみにする：26825_tanoshiminisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the day we can meet again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再|ふたた}び⟦チャンピオン→チャンピオン：19399_chanpion⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{再|ふたた}び⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}さないで→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't repeat the same mistake again.

notes:
{再|ふたた}び is a formal or literary way to say "again." It emphasizes that something is happening for a second time after a notable gap or interval, often carrying a sense of significance or drama.

USAGE:
Common in written Japanese, news, speeches, and literature. Rarely used in casual conversation, where ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧ or ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧ are preferred.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {再|ふたた}び⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit again
- {再|ふたた}び⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧: to stand up again, to recover
- ⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧{再|ふたた}び〜ない: never again (emphatic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧: again (casual, everyday — most common)
- ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧: one more time (neutral, often a request)
- ⟦{再度|さいど}→再度：11690_saido⟧: again (formal, used in business/official contexts)
- ⟦{改|あらた}めて→改めて：08526_aratamete⟧: anew, afresh (starting over with fresh intent)
